responsibility: Declares the MIR interpreter module structure and serves as the public integration surface for `interpret`, re-exporting the core interpreter types, memory/place/operand abstractions, machine traits, interning and validation APIs, and selected intrinsic helpers used by the rest of rustc.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the root of the general MIR interpreter subsystem, reexporting core interpreter, memory, machine, and visiting abstractions. The `const_eval/mod.rs` file uses that interpreter for CTFE-specific queries and helpers, so its scope is narrower and more policy-specific than this interpreter root.
